name: secops_pii_discovery
title: Evolving High-Fidelity PII & Secret Heuristics
problem_description: Discover a dictionary of optimal Regex patterns and string indicators that accurately classify PII (emails, SSNs, IPv4) and leaked Cloud/LLM API credentials (AWS Secret Access Keys, Stripe, GCP JSONs, OpenAI API keys) in raw codebase and chat completion traces, minimizing false positives on benign Python and JavaScript code variables.
initial_program_description: Define a standalone Python dictionary named 'PATTERNS' and a function 'scrub(text)' and 'audit_report(text)' that detects and counts PII and secret leaks across 8+ standard and advanced categories.
evolve_block_description: The 'PATTERNS' dictionary value mappings (keys: EMAIL, PHONE, SSN, IPV4, AWS_KEY, STRIPE_KEY, GCP_KEY, OPENAI_KEY; values: valid optimized Python re.compile regex string patterns).
constraints: Must output valid, syntactically correct Python Regex patterns.
Must avoid re.compile or memory leaks by using valid escaping.
Must maintain 100% precision on benign variable names containing 'key', 'secret', or 'email'.
